claims: The NASA Artemis II mission successfully launched on Wednesday, April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket carried four astronauts into orbit.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission around the moon.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket launched successfully from Launch Complex 39B.
The Orion spacecraft is currently in orbit.
Astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen are on board the Artemis II mission.
The Artemis II crew will travel around the moon.
The Artemis II mission marks the first crewed lunar mission in over 50 years.
